summary: Southland Holdings, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting entry into a material definitive agreement: a Settlement Agreement with Liberty Mutual and Zurich to resolve surety losses related to the WSCC Project judgment. The Company will pay $5 million by September 30, 2026, to settle approximately $36.4 million of Liberty's losses, expecting a favorable pre-tax income impact of ~$29 million in Q3 2026. This is a routine litigation settlement, not a corporate special situation, so no deal terms apply. Watch for ongoing negotiations with Zurich and accounting treatment updates.
